ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white) to 35% low-intensity (black/mottled) pixels; dark pixels are primarily concentrated along the distal edges and central notch region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white zones in the center of both lobes. Contiguous low-intensity dark regions follow the entire trailing edge boundary. A cluster of four vertically-oriented dark blobs is localized on the right lobe (image-right) between the mid-lobe and trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 40-45 degrees; bounding box depth is approximately 20% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular high-frequency serration; peaks and valleys range from 5 to 15 pixels in amplitude; highest frequency of variation is observed on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory from distal tips toward the lobe center, followed by a transition to convexity near the mid-lobe, returning to a sharp concavity at the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark circular pixel clusters (potential barnacle attachment sites) are visible along the distal trailing edge of the left lobe and the lower section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct dark linear mark, approximately 40 pixels in length, is visible at a diagonal orientation on the lower section of the right lobe (image-right).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular tissue loss and ragged edges on both distal tips, specifically a deep notch on the left distal tip (image-left).
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive 'four-finger' vertical dark pigmentation pattern on the right lobe mid-section.
